<italic>outworks; port, market place</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Esth. I, 2, end פ' ברייאתא וכ' Var. (ed. Lag. פורטתא; oth. ed. פנדתא, Var. פדוו', corr. acc.) the outer precincts &c.—B. Mets. 73

<notes> Ex. R. s. 5 יום פ' של פרעה וכ' it was Pharaoh’s day of reception of ambassadors &c.; Tanḥ. Vaëra 5 פרוזבטיא (corr. acc.). Meg. 15
<sup>a</sup> sq. זה בא בפרוזבולי וזה בא בפ' (Ms. M. בפרוס בולי בפרוס ביטי …) the one (Haman) had come to court as a member of the boulé (senate, πρὸς βουλῇ), and the other (Mordecai) as one of the legates (to plead for the building of the Temple); Yalk. Esth. 1045 ומשם ירדי פ' וכ' (not ירד פרוזבי') and from there they (Mordecai and Haman) went down (to Shushan) as legates &c.; אמרו ישראל … לפיכך יֵרֵד פְרוּזְבּוּטָן כנגדו (not פרוזבוטו) the Israelites said, Mordecai is …, therefore let him go as our legate against him (Haman); Yalk. Am. 545 פרווטי' (corr. acc.); v. next art.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (πρεσβευτής, v. 
<xref rid="Q01644">preced.</xref>) 
<italic>ambassador, legate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 42 מדינה ששלחה פ' לעטר וכ' (not טים …) a province that sent a legate to offer a crown to the king. Tanḥ. Vayigg. 6 שלח יהורה פרוזבטים אצלו (corr. acc.) he (Jacob) sent Judah as an ambassador to him (Joseph). Yalk. Esth. 1058 שונאי הוא שירדתי עמו בפ' he (Mordecai) is my enemy, since I came down with him (from Palestine) as a legate (to plead against the building of the Temple, v. preced.).—
<italic>Pl.</italic> פְּרוּזְבּוּטִין. Y’lamd. to Deut. I, 1, quot. in Ar. פרזבטין, v. פְּרוֹזְבִּיטְרֹון.—Greek 
<plural-form>pl. פְּרוּזְבּוּטֵי</plural-form> q. v.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q01646">
<head-word>פְּרֹוזְבֹּול</head-word>
<head-word>פְּרֹוסְבֹּול</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (an abbrev. of πρὸς βουλῇ βουλευτῶν, v. בּוּלְבּוּטֵיס) 
<italic>prosbul, a declaration made in court, before the execution of a loan, to the effect that the law of limitation by the entrance of the Sabbatical year shall not apply to the loan to be transacted</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebi. X, 4; Gitt. 36
<sup>a</sup> זהו גופו של פ' מוסרני לכם וכ' this is the body (formula) of a 
<italic>prosbol</italic>, ‘I declare before you—, judges in the place—, that I shall collect any debt that I may have outstanding with—, whenever I desire,’ and this is attested by the judges or witnesses. Shebi. X, 3 פ' אינו משמט the 
<italic>prosbol</italic> has the effect of preventing limitation; כשראה התקין הלל פ' … when he observed that people refused to loan to one another and thus violated what is written in the Law (Deut. XV, 9), Hillel introduced the 
<italic>prosbol</italic>. Gitt. 36
<sup>b</sup> כי התקין הלל פ' לדריה וכ' when Hillel instituted the 
<italic>prosbol</italic>, did he ordain it for his time only or for all time to come? Shebi. X, 5 פ' המוקדם כשר וכ' a 
<italic>prosbol</italic> written out before the loan is legal, if after the loan, it is illegal. Tosef. ib. VIII, 10; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּרֹוזְבּוּלִין, פְּרֹוזְבְּלִין, פְּרֹוסְ'</plural-form>. Tosef. B. Bath. XI, 7. Tosef. B. Mets. I, 9.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פָּרַט) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>small change</italic>, in gen. 
<italic>money</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 97
<sup>a</sup> (the Messiah will not come) עד שתכלה פ' מן הכיס until the money is gone from the bag (general poverty will prevail). Pesik. Baḥod., p. 101
<sup>b</sup>; Yalk. Ex. 271 בראשונה שהיתה הפ' מצויה וכ' (not בראשון) formerly when money was plentiful, people were anxious to hear a word of the Mishnah &c. (legal discussions), ועכשיו שאין הפ' מצויה וכ' but now when money is scarce (Israel is poor) …, people want to hear a word of the Bible &c. (cheering the soul); a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>p’ruṭah</italic>, a small coin, one eighth of the 
<italic>as</italic> (אִיסָר). Kidd. I, 1. Shebu. VI, 1; B. Mets. IV, 7 שוה פ' the value of a P’ruṭah; a. v. fr.—Ned. 33
<sup>b</sup> קא מהני ליה פ' דרב יוסף he gains the poor man’s penny of R. Joseph (who considers the keeper of a lost object a paid guardian, because, while engaged in one religious work, he is exempt from every other religious duty that may arise).—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּרוּטוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Kidd. I, 58
<sup>d</sup> bot. B. Mets. l. c. חמש פ' הן there are five cases in which the value of a P’ruṭah is legally recognized. Ib. 55
<sup>a</sup> אין אונאה לפ' there is no redress in cases of overreaching where the claim is only P’ruṭahs (less than one 
<italic>as</italic>). Ib. 46
<sup>a</sup> Ar. (ed. פְּרוֹטְטוֹת). Pes. 50
<sup>b</sup> ארבעה פ' אין בהן וכ' in four pennies (ways of earning a livelihood) there is never a sign of blessing &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>drop</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. as ab. Kel. II, 6 מוציא פ'</plural-form> a vessel letting liquid out in drops, 
<italic>dropping-bottle</italic>.—[Y. Kil. VIII, 31
<sup>c</sup> bot., v. פְּרוּטִיּוֹת].</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>the imperial bust</italic> of the Roman standards, to which divine honors were paid (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Signa, a. Joseph. B. J. II, 9; 2).</definition>
<notes> Ex. <sup>a</sup> שלא יהו דברי תורה בעיניך כפ' וכ' that the words of the Law be not in thy eyes like an old proclamation, but like a new one, which all run to read; Yalk. Prov. 960. Pesik. <sup>b</sup> פ' מאהבה a Pharisee from love (of reward, Rashi); פ' (מ)יראה from fear (of punishment); פ' שיכמי, ניקפי &c., v. respective determinants.—

<sup>a</sup> לבם של פ' עליך the Pharisees are opposed to thee in their hearts; a. fr.—Fem. פְּרוּשָׁה. Sot. III, 4 אשה פ'

<entry id="Q01754">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to break through</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bloom, sprout</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become white, spread all over</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Neg. VIII, 1 הפורח מן הטמא טהור a leprosy that ‘blossoms’ after the person has been declared unclean, is clean. Ib. 2 פָּרְחָה בכולו if it spread over the entire body. Ib. VII, 5 עד שתִּפְרַח בכולו until it spreads over &c.; a. fr.—2)

<sup>c</sup> top הלוחות היו מבקשין לִפְרוֹחַ the tablets wanted to fly (off Moses’ hands); הכתב עצמו פ' only the letters flew off; כיון שפ' הכתב וכ' when the letters had flown off, the tablets became too heavy for Moses’ hands. Ab. Zar. 18
<sup>a</sup> (of a martyr dying on the pyre) גוילין … פּוֹרְחוֹת I see the sheets of the book of the Law burn, and the letters fly off. Ḥag. 15
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 106
<sup>b</sup> מגדל הפורח באויר, v. מִגְדָּל. Ḥag. I, 8 פּוֹרְחִין באויר, v. הֶיתֵּר; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 93, a. e. פָּרְחָה נשמתן their soul fled, i.e. they were shocked by surprise, fear &c.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִפְרִיחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bloom, blossom</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. l. c. וה' בו בלילה וכ' the same night it blossomed and brought forth fruit; Tanḥ. Aḥăré 8 הִפְרִיחוּ ועשו פירות. Lev. R. s. 23; Cant. R. to II, 2 מַפְרחַת, v. כָּמַשׁ; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause sprouting, produce</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 37 אתמול מַפְרִיחַ מצות וכ' yesterday producing meritorious and noble deeds, and to-day so selfish!, v. כָּנַן; Yalk. ib. 62; Yalk. Ps. 832.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be able to fly, be fledged</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. XII, 3 (140
<sup>b</sup>) אפרוחים מַפְרִיחִין full-fledged birds; ib. 141
<sup>a</sup>. B. Mets. l. c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to fly; to chase</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. III, 3 מַפְרִיחֵי יונים, v. יוֹנָה II. Gen. R. s. 67; Yalk. Prov. 950 ומַפְרִיחָן and let them fly off, v. סִכְסֵךְ I. Y. Yoma II, 39
<sup>c</sup> top הִפְרִיחָתוֹ הרוח the wind drove it off (the altar). Y. Erub. I, 19
<sup>b</sup> bot. ובאת הרוח והִפְרִיחָתָהּ and a wind came and carried it (the Succah) off; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to place beyond due limits, to cause to protrude</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 29
<sup>b</sup>, sq. לא שנו אלא (ב)מַפְרִיחַ this has been taught (that he is responsible for damage) only when he places the thorns on his ground so that they protrude into the public road, opp. מצמצם when he puts them exactly where his limits end. Tosef. ib. II, 5 המפריח גדירו … לרשות הרבים he who causes his fence of thorns or stones to protrude into the public road.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split, open</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to break into small change, to change money</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Maas. Sh. II, 8, sq. הפורט סלע וכ' he who breaks (changes at the banker’s) a Sela of second-tithes money. B. Bath. 8
<sup>b</sup> גבאי צדקה … פּוֹרְטִין וכ' charity treasurers that have no poor among whom to distribute, may exchange for others (at a fee for the benefit of the fund), but not for themselves. Ex. R. s. 35 יש אדם פורט זהוב וכ' a man changes one gold piece, and covers with it many expenses; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to single out, specify</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. Mishp., s. 5 משמע שניהם כאחת … עד שיִפְרוֹט לך הכתוב יחדו the Vav conjunctive may mean both together (
<italic>and</italic>), or each separately (
<italic>or</italic>), unless the text explicitly states ‘together’ (as Deut. XXII, 10, sq.); Snh. 85
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. שיְפָרֵט (
<italic>Pi.</italic>). Pes. 21
<sup>b</sup> כל מקום … עד שיפרוט לך הכתוב כדרך שפ' וכ' wherever the Law says, ye shall not eat &c., it implies the prohibition of both eating and using, unless the text explicitly permits the use as it does with reference to carcasses (Deut. XIV, 21). Mekh. Bo, s. 5 פרסמו ופְרָטוֹ וכ' (or ופֵרְטוֹ 
<italic>Pi.</italic>) the Scripture publishes and specifies him (by name); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
